grh_661d86f9e4d9b5d58978.title: A Test of Love
paragraphs: Wealthy industrialist Paul Cunningham suspects that his wife Lisa values his fortune more than she values him, so he arranges a fake kidnapping to test her. Instead of trying to save Paul, Lisa and her lover Roberto stall the ransom demand and ultimately tell the supposed kidnappers to kill him so she can inherit. They then discover that Paul's newly revised will, which would have left Lisa almost everything, was never signed and that the earlier valid will gives most of his estate to charities while leaving her only an allowance. Paul appears alive with his attorney and investigators, revealing that the kidnapping and murder were staged and recorded. He tells Lisa that if she had tried to save him he would have signed the generous will, and adds that he is terminally ill, so her greed has cost her the fortune she might soon have inherited.

Other credited names include Fletcher Markle as director, Fletcher Markle as producer, Ken Gerard as writer, and [[person|vincent-price|Vincent Price]] as host.

grh_666a5721fcc54c92bb78.title: Roughneck
paragraphs: Jockey Joseph Meadows is badly injured when thrown from his horse Roughneck and is left unable to move his legs. Another doctor expects permanent paralysis, but Dr. Christian believes Meadows may recover if he has a powerful enough reason to fight. Meadows' fourteen-year-old son Jimmy is determined to get Roughneck into the Memorial Stakes, the big race his father had been working toward before the accident. Christian takes Jimmy and the horse under his wing, reins in the boy's attempts to gamble for the entry fee and helps Rivers End raise the money by selling small shares in Roughneck. The approaching race gives Meadows a goal, and his rehabilitation progresses from a specially built walker to crutches. At the Memorial Stakes Jimmy rides Roughneck as the Rivers End entry. Roughneck wins by half a length, and in the excitement Meadows suddenly realizes he has risen to his feet without his crutches. The horse's victory becomes the final push in Meadows' own recovery.

grh_6663ca7f914112a04a81.title: It's a Knockout
paragraphs: Harry and several confederates lure wealthy Stan Pierce into a supposedly fixed boxing match in Havana. After convincing Pierce that the result is certain, they take his $45,000 wager and stage a fighter's apparent death with blanks, fake blood and a bogus doctor, frightening Pierce into fleeing Cuba before he can demand his money back. The elaborate swindle works until Harry opens the money satchel and discovers that Jenny, the woman who helped hook Pierce, has disappeared with the proceeds. Her note leaves Harry to explain the loss to the rest of the gang, turning one of his neatest confidence games into a double cross on himself.
